metadata.description: Official theo-memory plugin for Claude Code — managed three-tier memory with auto-capture + recall.

plugins.name: theo-memory
plugins.description: theo-memory — the managed three-tier (User/Session/Agent) memory layer for Claude Code. Auto-captures durable facts (Stop summary + PreCompact flush), recalls relevant memory into context (UserPromptSubmit), and blocks secret writes — via lifecycle hooks + the theo-memory MCP.
